Specification: This specification is a small test module for TLC operators and library functionality rather than a distributed algorithm. It defines a fold-like operator FApply over finite-domain functions, a BoundedSeq operator that constructs all sequences over a set up to a given length, simple arithmetic helpers Plus and Times, and an invariant Inv that checks a collection of expected TLC evaluation results using Print and Assert. The model uses a single variable x with a trivial stuttering Next action x' = x, and the main substantive content is the state predicate Inv containing test assertions about function application, bounded sequences, sequence lengths, and sequence sorting.

IF FApply(<<>> , Plus, 7) = 7 THEN Print("Test 4 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 4 Failed")

IF <<1, 2, 3>> \notin BoundedSeq(1..3, 2) THEN Print("Test 6 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 6 Failed")

IF \A s \in BoundedSeq({"a", "b", "c"}, 2) : Len(s) \leq 2 THEN Print("Test 9 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 10 Failed")
IF SortSeq(<<3, 2, 4, 2>>, \leq) = <<2, 2, 3, 4>> THEN Print("Test 10 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 12 Failed")
IF SortSeq(<<3, 2, 4, 2>>, <) = <<2, 2, 3, 4>> THEN Print("Test 11 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 13 Failed")
IF SortSeq(<<>>, >) = <<>> THEN Print("Test 12 OK", TRUE) ELSE Assert(FALSE, "Test 14 Failed")
